subject: Provisional hold request: Peregrine-3b multimodal variant + telemetry gating
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Peregrine-3b variant: provisional hold request + quick compat questions

Team —

Quick summary: Acme AI flagged a new Peregrine-3b multimodal variant (name: peregrine-3b-v1-mm) they're planning to use for a customer-facing routing experiment. They asked if we can onboard it next sprint, but there are two immediate asks from product/security that make me want to request a provisional hold (pin) while we run fast compatibility checks:

- Tokenizer parity: includes a small change to byte-level normalization; need to confirm no token id drift.
- KV cache layout: artifact manifest indicates a modified KV stride that could affect cache reuse.
- Multimodal ops: variant uses an image prefix fusion op we haven't exercised in production.

Action requested from Model Intake/Serving:
1) Provisional pin of "peregrine-3b-v1-mm" to prevent automatic rollouts until we complete validation (proposed window: 7 days).
2) Triage checklist run: tokenizer parity, fused-attention kernel availability, KV cache binary layout check, and a small perf smoke on a staging GPU.
3) Telemetry gating: propose gating metrics (latency 95p < 220ms, token error rate < 0.5%, dropped sessions < 0.1%).

Attachments: sample eval prompts, the Acme artifact-manifest.json (they attached). See attached: peregrine-3b-eval-prompts.zip, artifact-manifest.json.

Business note: Acme is asking for an expedited intake (they have a pilot next month). If we can do a provisional hold and a 48–72h triage, product can decide whether to proceed or ask them to fallback to peregrine-3b-compat-lite.

Can someone own the provisional pin request + quick compatibility run?

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Product Manager, Model Intake
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Peregrine-3b variant: provisional hold request + quick compat questions

Ava —

Thanks for the heads up. I can take the tokenizer and KV layout checks; Priyom, can you take perf / kernel availability? Marcus, FYI on rollout gating.

Checklist I'll run (will report back in ~24h):
- Tokenizer parity: byte-normalization unit tests + sampling of 500 prompts from their eval set.
- Token id diff report (mapping mismatches list).
- KV cache binary header check: whether stride/segment sizes differ from our runtime expectations.
- Forward run on staging (1 GPU, sequence lengths 512/1024) to validate memory growth and immediate OOM risk.

If we see token id drift > 0.2% we should NOT allow pin to automatically promote to prod; request stop-gap: convert to compat-lite or ask Acme to retokenize.

Please attach artifact URLs and the tokenizer.json (if separate). If they only sent a wheel, ask for tokenizer files.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Peregrine-3b variant: provisional hold request + quick compat questions

Ack — I can run kernel availability and a perf smoke. Notes:
- If fused image-prefix ops are missing on our current kernel set, the model should still run but at degraded perf if the variant falls back to slower kernels. I will check Triton/cuDNN availability and whether we need a custom fused kernel.
- Proposed provisional pin: 7-day hold with two triggers to cancel earlier: (a) all triage checks pass, or (b) we detect a hard incompatibility (tokenizer/kv mismatch).

Telemetry gating proposal (quick):
- Canary window: 5000 sessions or 48 hours (whichever first).
- Metrics to watch: 95th latency, error rate (RPC errors or tokenization mismatches), memory growth slope.

Runbook draft (link): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-peregrine-runbook
I'll create a quick intake ticket and attach the artifact-manifest to the ticket.

- Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. ML Engineer, Inference Optimizations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sam Ortega <sam@acme.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Peregrine-3b variant: provisional hold request + quick compat questions

Thanks for the quick responses — appreciate the triage. For artifacts we've uploaded the following to our S3 share (link in artifact-manifest.json):
- model.tar.gz (weights + config)
- tokenizer.json + merges.txt
- kv_layout.txt (binary header description)
- small eval set (~600 prompts) — same as attached zip in your email

A few clarifications:
- The tokenizer change is a normalization tweak to better handle accented characters; it should only affect ~0.1% of tokens on English corpora but we're happy to run your tests.
- The fused image-prefix op is in an optional branch; we can provide a fallback artifact without it if needed.

Expedite request: our pilot is in mid-Jan; any provisional hold + triage completed within 72 hours would be ideal. Let us know what additional artifacts you need.

Best,
Sam Ortega
Platform Lead
Acme AI

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Decision: provisional hold approved + owners and next steps

Team —

Decision: provisional 7-day hold approved for peregrine-3b-v1-mm starting now. Rationale: business impact (Acme pilot) + manageable technical risk. Scope and owners:
- Laura: tokenizer parity & KV layout checks (deliverable: token-id diff report + KV header summary) — due 2026-12-04 18:00 PST.
- Priyom: kernel availability + perf smoke (deliverable: staging perf log + kernel fallback notes) — due 2026-12-04 20:00 PST.
- Ava: coordinate with Acme for fallback artifact if token issues > threshold and own any communications with product.
- Soojin: please prep the canary target and set telemetry alerts per Priyom's gating proposal.

Canary plan (short):
- Canary traffic: 5k sessions or 48h.
- Gating thresholds: 95p latency <= 220ms, token error rate <= 0.5%, OOM/error spikes < 0.1% of sessions.

Attachments: intake-runbook.md (finalized) is attached to the intake ticket DOCS-INTAKE-4587.

Please ack and update the intake ticket with artifacts. If any owner needs more time, call it out now — otherwise we'll proceed with the triage and I will reconvene on Friday for a go/no-go.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Model Ops
Redwood Inference
